about: Proposed text_blocks.read_aloud overrides for screen and figure blocks: a short spoken description used by narration instead of the block's HTML. Drafted with model help from text_blocks.data.fields and the surrounding prose. Each is pinned to the block's sha256; if the block changes, the override no longer applies. status 'unreviewed' means no person has signed off yet.

overrides.read_aloud: The sign reads: {zui fia kun zun}.
Zei's watch shows: {mun gui} eighteen forty-two, {tei} seventy thousand, and a large checkmark.
The poster reads: {pa jan li sun zo}, {zai gau fe pa jan}. {go li sun zo}, {bai gau fe go}.

The slide shows two jars of gas, each holding a few molecules drawn as dots, with arrows for their velocities: long arrows in the left jar, short ones in the right. Under each jar is a dot, times ten to the sixth. The left jar's range is zero to nine hundred ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-nine; the right jar's is zero to ninety-nine.

The two jars are now joined into one, and every molecule has a medium-length arrow. The label reads: a dot, times two times ten to the sixth, ranging from zero to four hundred ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-nine.
